title: Unauthenticated destructive /api/test/* endpoints have no negative test proving they are disabled outside smoke-test mode
test: tests/testControlEndpoints.test.js: 'the /api/test control endpoints answer 404 and change nothing when NEXTRA_SMOKE_TEST is unset'
proof: The gap was a missing test, and server.js already refuses all three routes unless NEXTRA_SMOKE_TEST === '1' (and the caller is loopback), so the new test passes on the unchanged code. The new test spawns the real server.js with the flag deleted, requests /api/test/shutdown, /api/test/unhandled-rejection and /api/test/kill-media-worker from loopback, and asserts 404, the server still running, /healthz 200, the media worker alive, and (after all three) the server pid and mediaWorker pid in /api/metrics unchanged. Checked against three temporary mutants of server.js, each with the flag check removed from one endpoint (reverted; server.js unchanged): every mutant fails the test with 'expected 404, actual 202' naming that endpoint. Teardown uses child.kill(), not /api/test/shutdown; on Windows the mediasoup worker exits with the server (asserted).
